detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Dynamics in Musical Experience
detail.summary: Drafted a provisional notebook for project proj-music-004, synthesizing evidence regarding music-induced emotion as active interoceptive inference and the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) hypothesis. These sources collectively support the view that musical beat perception relies on motor simulation and predictive timing mechanisms. Addressed overdue research commitment by queuing focused investigation into decision theory frameworks relative to human values.
